item.title: Karnataka mulls social media ban for under 16; Rozana secures Rs 290 Cr in Series B round
item.description: Presenting the State’s Budget on Friday, Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah said, "With the objective of preventing adverse effects of increasing mobile usage on children, usage of social media will be banned for children under the age of 16.”

item.title: Flipkart asks 300 employees to leave under its annual performance review
item.description: These latest exits impact about 2% of Flipkart's current workforce. According to data available on Tracxn, Flipkart had over 15,000 employees as of August 2025. These develoments come as Fipkart gears for its public market debut.

item.title: Priya Agarwal Hebbar on why women are key to India’s mining and manufacturing future
item.description: On International Women’s Day, Vedanta's Priya Agarwal Hebbar speaks about breaking barriers in the traditionally male-dominated mining sector, why women’s participation is critical to India’s industrial future, and the need to redesign workplaces for a truly inclusive workforce.

item.title: [Weekly funding roundup Feb 28-March 6] VC fund raise falls below $100M level
item.description: Venture capital funding saw a steep fall in the the first week of March largely due to lesser number of deals.

item.title: Electric passenger vehicle registrations jump 44% in February
item.description: EV retail sales in India surged 44% in February, with Tata Motors leading the passenger segment. Two-wheeler sales also jumped 46% to over 1.11 lakh units, according to dealer's body FADA.

item.title: The future of procurement in India’s supply chain ecosystem
item.description: Rising geopolitical risks and unpredictable global demand are bringing procurement into the boardroom, as sourcing choices now directly affect business stability and growth.

item.title: Unifying the data landscape: Insights from Firebolt's CXO mixer on scaling modern platforms
item.description: Addressing tool fatigue and the rising demands of AI, industry leaders gathered to share practical approaches for streamlining modern data architectures and accelerating product innovation.

item.title: The micromanagement trap: when founder control kills growth
item.description: Trying to approve every tiny decision? That might be the real reason your startup feels stuck. Learn how excessive control harms teams and how to fix it.

item.title: Why smartphones slow down over time (and how to fix it)
item.description: That smartphone you bought 3 years ago felt lightning fast. Now it struggles with basic apps. Here’s what’s really going on.
